articles.title: Florida Legal Action Targets Major Insulin Manufacturers Over Inflated Drug Pricing Practices
articles.summary: Florida officials have launched a lawsuit against major insulin manufacturers, alleging deceptive trade practices and artificially inflated drug prices that burden patients and commercial health plans.
